import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Pull latest
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git pull origin main 2>&1 | tail -10")
print("Pulled:", stdout.read().decode())
# Fix tsconfig
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('sed -i "s/moduleResolution.*bundler/moduleResolution: NodeNext/" /opt/areloria/server/tsconfig.json')
print("Fixed tsconfig")
# Add type module to root
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('sed -i "s/\"private\": true/\"private\": true,\n  \"type\": \"module\"/" /opt/areloria/package.json')
# Rebuild
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -10")
print("\nBuild:", stdout.read().decode())
# Start with PM2
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 delete all && pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs && sleep 10")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/health")
print("\nHealth:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
